verdict.rationale: Baseten lets ML engineers self-deploy any open-weight model quickly via Truss (config.yaml + `uvx truss push`, no Dockerfile/container management) onto dedicated GPUs, which enables fast access to newly released open-weight weights on the platform. However, there is no evidence about how quickly Baseten's curated Model APIs catalog itself adds newly released open-weight models, nor any track record/announcement cadence showing rapid catalog updates after public model releases. missing for 10: evidence of Model APIs catalog turnaround time for new open-weight releases, release-day availability examples, or announcements demonstrating speed of curated catalog additions.
